items.title: Eddie Morris Interview, 1958-12-21
items.q: Joe Lindsay used to play drum. Johnny Lindsay on trombone, Joe Lindsay on drum.

ctx.x: He come from uptown. Uptown. That way. And Joe Lindsay used to play drum. Johnny Lindsay on trombone, Joe Lindsay on drum. And then after Johnny Lindsay, I believe, he went on bass. And after he died, I believe.
I asked Joe if they were related and he said no.
He had eight brothers. They're brothers. Johnny.
